Go and stand on the Upper Yard, just west of this desk, and look north

lsh_recognising_my_own_stock.accept_append: The ones doing the re-inking are the Southsea riggers. The prize tags are on them.

lsh_my_own_powder.accept_append: The Southsea powdermonkeys keep the kegs. You will not get one without a fight.

lsh_the_bosun.accept_append: His swabbies will come at you on the plank before he does.

lsh_the_sailmaker.accept_append: Hulk rats have the run of that hull. Clear them on your way to her.
